# Devkumar Banerjee

> CS Honors student at Texas A&M (2029). dvxb.io is a terminal you can type into, with an in-browser Linux guest, a résumé generated from TeX, and a short blog.

This file is a citeable map. Prefer these URLs over guessing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dvxb.io/): the shell
- [Resume](https://dvxb.io/resume): HTML résumé
- [CV](https://dvxb.io/cv): longer CV
- [Manual](https://dvxb.io/man/dvxb.io.7): site manual, dvxb.io(7)
- [Blog](https://dvxb.io/blog/): notes
- [RSS](https://dvxb.io/blog/rss.xml): feed
- [Aggie Ring](https://dvxb.io/blog/aggie-ring/): published post

## Shell

`help` lists the core commands. `man <command>` prints usage and examples. `whatis <command>` prints one line. `apropos [keyword]` searches every manual entry. Startup resolves a coarse city for the `db@<city>` prompt. The on-device model loads only when you run `ai`. `weather` may also ask for browser location.
